mainImage.alt: An ambulance crew responds after housing was destroyed by an Israeli air strike in Nabatieh, southern Lebanon.
mainImage.caption: Representative image: Destruction in Lebanon from Israeli airstrikes. The Tebnine Government Hospital was bombed twice in two days in April 2026, part of Israel's systematic destruction of Lebanon's healthcare infrastructure.
